summary: Register an invoke handler that is removed after handling one invocation.

target.notes: Removal must occur with Electron-compatible one-shot semantics even when handler execution is asynchronous.

caveats: Concurrent invocations must not accidentally run the one-shot handler more than Electron would.
references: Electron IPC tutorial / Structured Clone semantics

tests.name: single invoke
tests.expected_behavior: first invoke is handled and the handler is then removed

tests.name: second invoke
tests.expected_behavior: second invocation has no registered handler and must fail according to Electron semantics
